title: MECHANISTIC INTERPRETABILITY OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS WITH APPLICATIONS TO THE FINANCIAL SERVICES INDUSTRY
reasoning: The paper conducts experiments evaluating the model's ability to identify violations of Fair Lending laws and UDAAP (Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices). These tasks involve benchmarking the model's performance on scenarios related to discrimination (including religion, sex, and race) and ethical/legal compliance in financial services.
